result.summary: The page appears to be a well-structured food delivery app home screen. After analyzing the layout, content, and styling, I found no significant visual defects. The horizontally scrollable carousels and bottom-clipped content are expected behaviors.

issues.description: The first two 'Fastest near you' entries appear to be identical duplicate listings ('Green Bowl Poké' with the same €0.90 delivery, 15-25 min, and same image).
issues.suggestion: Verify whether these are genuinely two separate locations. If duplicates, deduplicate the list or add distinguishing details (e.g., location/branch name) to clarify.
